title: PDU EAP result message transport procedure initiation

entities.name: PDU EAP result message transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by SMF when PDU session authentication and authorization is performed after PDU session establishment and DN authentication completes successfully. Used to transport EAP result message to UE.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: NAS message created by SMF to transport EAP result message to UE during PDU EAP result message transport procedure.

entities.name: PTI IE
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity information element in PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message, set to 'No procedure transaction identity assigned'.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information element containing the EAP-success message provided by the DN, included in PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.

entities.name: DN authentication completes successfully
entities.description: Condition where the DN authentication of the UE completes successfully after PDU session establishment.

entities.name: SMF creates PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message
entities.description: Behavior where SMF creates the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message to initiate the procedure.

entities.name: UE passes EAP message to upper layers
entities.description: Behavior where UE passes the EAP message received in EAP message IE to upper layers upon receipt of PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.

relations.description: Procedure initiation requires that DN authentication completes successfully after PDU session establishment.
Procedure includes the step where SMF creates PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains PTI IE.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains EAP message IE.
SMF creating the message establishes the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
UE behavior establishes that EAP message from EAP message IE is passed to upper layers.
